ad.title: Plant Tycoon
ad.copy: A gardening simulation where players grow, prune, and crossbreed plants to discover rare species and solve a genetic puzzle to find the six Magic Plants of Isola, while managing plant health, harvesting seeds, selling creations, and customizing a virtual nursery.

explanation: 选择 ad_16120（品类 Simulation）的理由：场景与「ad_16120」的目标标签匹配，且该候选在候选集中排序最前。置信度 0.85。在同一场景下，候选集中还有 ad_351030(Casual)、ad_317470(Massively Multiplayer)、ad_348620(Adventure)、ad_522230(Simulation)、ad_3258290(Adventure) 等 29 条，但它们的品类或目标标签与本场景的匹配度更低。
